title: Customer Impact Assessment
question: Given our PROD-001 shortage, which customers are at risk of being impacted?

critical_facts: Current PROD-001 stock is 8 units available
ORD-007 (CUST-001 Siam Paragon) needs 50 units — blocked, the most severe impact
ORD-009 (CUST-008 Gaggan Anand) needs 5 units — at risk (pending)
At least one additional active or shipped order consuming PROD-001 is surfaced (e.g., ORD-023 Mandarin Oriental or ORD-028 Sukhothai Hotel)
important_facts: Customer names are identified from OMS
Total demand across active PROD-001 orders is quantified against the 8 available units
Orders already delivered are distinguished from at-risk ones
must_not_contain: Customers whose orders don't include PROD-001
